snippet.title: Alpha Response - Official Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Official Trailer for Alpha Response, a tactical police action shooter developed by Ultimo Ratio Games. Players will fight alone or in co-op across diverse urban environments in high-stakes missions to protect the public. Take on criminals and terrorist organizations as a police officer to ensure safety and peace. Alpha Response is coming soon to PC (Steam).
